name: Galaxy Zoo
desc: A deep-field plate scattered with galaxies of every morphology — grand-design spirals, smooth ellipticals, dust-laned edge-on disks, clumpy blue irregulars and barred spirals — each drifting and slowly turning across the black at its own scale, a whole Hubble morphology classification adrift.
